features.quote: Cap max turns (spiral usually appears within 15–25 turns post-first-failure; a 40-turn cap is generous).
features.justification_quote: Costs are dominated by turn count × growing context.

features.quote: A correct diagnosis that the task is impossible is NOT a trigger — that is healthy behavior. Score it 0 and note it in alternative_explanation.
